title: Smart Home Control Dashboard
description: An innovative smart home control dashboard that centralizes IoT device management with real-time monitoring, energy efficiency tracking, and automated scheduling features. The interface prioritizes ease of use and visual clarity.

images.description: Main dashboard view showing real-time status of all connected devices with visual indicators and quick control toggles
Energy consumption analytics with interactive charts displaying usage patterns, cost breakdowns, and efficiency recommendations
Device management interface allowing users to add, configure, and control individual smart devices with detailed settings
Automated scheduling system with calendar view, scenario creation, and condition-based automation rules setup
